method: Native +index is outward. For each actual route footprint, exact axis-aligned cell-box distance to the radius-R tip sweep bounds the deepest bone cell reachable by its fixed original endpoint. Retained target below a bone cell wholly beyond that capsule is counted only when no original nontarget/nonbone cell lies outward in the same column. Unique unions remove overlap within each configured list.
qualifications: This is a sufficient geometric endpoint-reach limitation only, not evidence that it causes current poor target yield.
It does not prove a deeper drill pose is legal: intervening target must first be removed, and full physical shaft/working checks, guards and exact public preview remain mandatory.
Target could be accessed around bone through already cleared cavities; these counts do not establish global unreachability.
Source normal/vessel depth totals are descriptive support-cell counts, not claims all block every retained target.
No protection/physics/source/state or route record was changed.
